concern.concern: Step 1.1 says, 'Give X its natural finite CW structure with one vertex, core edges a,b,c, and 2-cells λ₂,λ₃'. Here X was defined as the union of two mapping cylinders: the common source circle c and the two target core circles are disjoint, so that actual space cannot have the asserted one-vertex structure with all three as core edges. The usual construction first includes the two connecting cylinder edges and then collapses their maximal tree to obtain the asserted presentation complex. That finite simple comparison is omitted from the claimed spine certificate.

The first assertion cannot hold for both ordered pairs: direction determines which diagonal pair occurs. Naming the two states would resolve this wording defect.
